prompt.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: a FIVE-FRAME SPRITE SHEET for this exact Song dynasty bearded man carrying a cord-tied wooden box: one standing pose plus one complete four-frame walk cycle, all walking toward the RIGHT of the image in the same three-quarter side view as the reference. Keep his identity: black topknot with a dark ribbon, short beard and moustache, long blue robe with cream lining, cream trousers, dark shoes, the SAME square wooden box tied with cord, held in both arms in front of his chest in every cell; the box and arms barely move. The head stays at the same height and the same horizontal position in every walking cell; the body only bobs very slightly. Cell 1 = standing at rest, feet together, facing right. Cell 2 = contact: right leg forward with heel touching the ground, left leg back on its toes, longest stride. Cell 3 = passing: weight on the right leg straight under the body, left leg bent and passing forward beside it, foot just off the ground. Cell 4 = contact: left leg forward with heel touching the ground, right leg back on its toes, longest stride, mirror of cell 2. Cell 5 = passing: weight on the left leg straight under the body, right leg bent and passing forward, foot just off the ground. Correct leg anatomy, the robe hem swings with the legs, no extra limbs. Fine ink outlines and muted antique Chinese watercolor exactly matching the reference, same line weight, same palette, same paper-grain shading. Truly transparent alpha background, no ground shadow, no glow, no grid lines, no numbers, no text. One single horizontal row of 5 equal-width cells, one full figure per cell, centered in its cell with generous margin so tools, cloth, grain and hands never touch a cell edge. Identical character size and identical camera angle in every cell. Redraw at higher detail than the small reference without changing the design. Make every cell match the reference figure and match each other as strictly as possible.
